authority: CEO Round 135: 'Every candidate/world pair must be assigned APPLICABLE/CONTROL/NOT_APPLICABLE with machine-readable justification. A simulator that cannot represent the mechanism is not evidence of survival.'

classification_scheme.FULLY_APPLICABLE: The world can directly test the candidate's mechanism. It has the relevant physics, constitutive model, and failure formulation.
classification_scheme.CONTROL: The world provides a baseline/null test. It lacks the mechanism-specific physics but can confirm whether the signal is an artifact of the specific formulation.
classification_scheme.NOT_APPLICABLE: The world cannot meaningfully constrain the candidate's mechanism. Using it would be epistemic noise.
classification_scheme.rule: Only FULLY_APPLICABLE worlds count toward promotion. CONTROL worlds must be resolved (pass or fail) but do not count as mechanism passes. NOT_APPLICABLE worlds are excluded with justification.

C1_R6_PASSIVE_RESCUE.mechanism: Passive bypass valve opens under pressure differential to restore CSF drainage.

WORLD_A_FEBIO.justification: FEM solid mechanics can model valve opening, pressure differential, and fluid-structure interaction.

WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.justification: No fracture involved. Peridynamics is a fracture/fragmentation simulator; valve opening is not a fracture problem.

WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.justification: CSF is not blood. clotFoam's platelet/coagulation model is specific to blood. The relevant fluid is CSF (cerebrospinal fluid), not blood with platelets.

WORLD_D_CALCULIX.justification: Independent FEM can model valve mechanics and pressure response. Different codebase from FEBio provides independent verification.

WORLD_E_SFEPY.justification: Linear elastic FEM can model basic valve deformation but cannot model contact/valve opening (no contact mechanics). Useful as elastic baseline.

C2_ADAPTIVE_SENSING_ESHUNT.mechanism: Continuous endovascular differential pressure monitoring detects obstruction via temporal signature.

WORLD_A_FEBIO.justification: FEM can model sensor mechanics in CSF environment and pressure wave propagation.

WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.justification: No fracture in the sensing mechanism. Peridynamics is irrelevant to pressure sensing.

WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.justification: CSF is not blood. clotFoam models blood clotting, not CSF pressure dynamics.

WORLD_D_CALCULIX.justification: Independent FEM can verify sensor mechanical response.

WORLD_E_SFEPY.justification: Linear elastic can model sensor diaphragm deformation as baseline.

C3_CONTROLLED_CNS_THERAPEUTIC.mechanism: Controlled retention mechanism sustains therapeutic concentration in CSF despite turnover.

WORLD_A_FEBIO.justification: FEM can model retention mechanism mechanics and coupled diffusion.

WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.justification: No fracture. Retention is a transport/diffusion problem, not a fracture problem.

WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.justification: Flow+transport model can simulate drug transport under CSF flow. This is the relevant physics for retention.

WORLD_D_CALCULIX.justification: FEM can model the mechanical aspect of the retention device but not the drug transport.

WORLD_E_SFEPY.justification: Linear elastic baseline for device mechanics.

C4_CNS_LIFECYCLE_INTELLIGENCE.mechanism: Merged sensor + biosensor + ML platform for predictive failure detection.

WORLD_A_FEBIO.justification: Can model individual sensor mechanics but not the merged platform or ML prediction.

WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.justification: No fracture in the platform mechanism.

WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.justification: Can model biosensor transport but not the ML/prediction aspect.

WORLD_D_CALCULIX.justification: Can model sensor mechanics but not the platform.

WORLD_E_SFEPY.justification: Cannot model sensors, ML, or prediction.

C4_CNS_LIFECYCLE_INTELLIGENCE.note: C4 is KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE. No applicable worlds needed.

C5_CLOT_FRAGMENTATION_PRECURSOR.mechanism: dD/dstrain deceleration precursor signal before thrombus fragmentation.

WORLD_A_FEBIO.justification: FEM + CDM + Simo CDF fracture. Directly tests whether continuum damage produces the precursor. This is the primary mechanism world.

WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.justification: Bond breakage is a fundamentally different fracture formulation. Tests whether the precursor survives when fracture mathematics changes from CDM to bond breakage. This is the load-bearing assumption A1 test.

WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.justification: Flow-driven clot dynamics tests whether the precursor survives when failure is driven by flow rather than prescribed displacement. This is the load-bearing assumption A2 test. NOTE: Currently custom implementation — must be replaced by actual clotFoam for promotion-grade evidence.

WORLD_D_CALCULIX.justification: Elastic-plastic FEM has NO fracture model. Cannot independently test a fracture precursor. Useful as a non-fracture baseline — if CalculiX shows a 'precursor', it would be an artifact of the elastic-plastic response, not a fracture precursor.

WORLD_E_SFEPY.justification: Linear elastic FEM has NO damage, NO fracture, NO plasticity. Cannot produce any damage evolution. SfePy's constant stiffness means d²F/dδ² = 0 everywhere — it CANNOT detect a precursor by construction. Useful only as a null/control confirming that the signal requires damage/fracture physics.

C5_CLOT_FRAGMENTATION_PRECURSOR.critical_finding: Only 3 worlds are FULLY_APPLICABLE for C5. The CEO is correct: SfePy and CalculiX are CONTROL worlds, not mechanism passes. The previous claim of '5 worlds passed' was misleading — only 3 can test the fracture precursor mechanism.
C5_CLOT_FRAGMENTATION_PRECURSOR.promotion_implication: C5 needs all 3 APPLICABLE worlds GREEN (FEBio, custom peridynamics, custom flow/clotFoam) + both CONTROL worlds resolved. Currently: FEBio=GREEN(negative), peridynamics=GREEN(negative), flow=GREEN(positive — CONTRADICTION). Controls: CalculiX=GREEN(negative, correct for non-fracture), SfePy=GREEN(negative, correct for no-damage).
